data.narrative: Devanshi selected a visual DAG representation to maximize team clarity, correctly classified hard versus soft dependencies, and diagnosed the circular dependency between provider vetting, provider data, and admin tooling as an architectural modeling flaw that required node splitting.

dimension_scores.observation: Transformed all Module 1 requirements into 12 cohesive, buildable work items without dropping scope.
dimension_scores.evidence: Generated 12 distinct work items covering auth, models, booking, reviews, payments, notifications, and disputes.

dimension_scores.observation: Modeled project as a Directed Acyclic Graph, distinguished technical hard dependencies from procedural soft dependencies, and traced critical path depth.
dimension_scores.evidence: Classified solid vs dashed edges and mapped 7-node critical path in artifacts/dag-module-02.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that delays on the critical path shift project release date whereas parallel branches contain buffer slack.
dimension_scores.evidence: Evaluated double-time delay impact on WI-04 vs unaffected search/notification branches.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed clear Mermaid flowchart and ASCII graph defining exact inputs, outputs, and start/endpoints.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created artifacts/dag-module-02.md with explicit in-degree 0 starting points and out-degree 0 endpoints.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized that circular dependencies cannot be solved by task reordering, and applied node splitting to break the cycle.
dimension_scores.evidence: Split Admin Dashboard into WI-12a (Minimal Review Tool) and WI-12b (Full Dashboard) and added pending state.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized that node splitting introduces an interface contract between the minimal review tool and the full admin dashboard.
dimension_scores.evidence: Documented schema compatibility requirements between pending state and approved state in dag-module-02.md.

strengths: Strong spatial reasoning and visual graph structure communication
Accurately distinguished hard technical blockers from soft procedural preferences
Decoupled circular dependency via architectural node splitting rather than superficial task reordering
data.recommendation: In Module 3, prioritize retiring high-uncertainty risks along the critical path before committing to downstream implementations.

public_evidence.student_action: Designed 13-node visual dependency graph, classified hard/soft dependencies, and resolved circular dependency deadlock via node splitting.
public_evidence.proof: Acyclic Mermaid flowchart and ASCII DAG with verified starting points, endpoints, and decoupled admin review tool.
public_evidence.ability: Models complex systems as Directed Acyclic Graphs and resolves circular dependency deadlocks
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates senior-level execution planning ability to prevent team blockers and parallelize workstreams.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Built acyclic dependency graph with 13 work items and classified hard vs soft edges
Traced longest sequential hard dependency path and calculated delivery floor
Broke circular dependency by decoupling data lifecycle and splitting admin dashboard node

teaching_approaches.detail: Demonstrated how house framing vs wiring analogy applies to software parallel workstreams
